resources.string: What is new in this APK

Top-row application update button. Group header runs one TCP and three URL probes per profile, with progress/cancel and persistent reliability-first ranking. The diagnostics tile displays the current result, age and proxy rates.

Update screen: larger multi-line status, one Down from Check to available Download, separate full-details reader.

Selected group first; separate operations row before final capabilities. Session counters and bounded Internet check with progress.

• Three launch cards: release information, TV and smartphone. The installed version is visible immediately.
• Each group has its own TV row. Available sections have direct buttons.
• Subscription names use provider metadata when available; custom names are preserved.
• Automatic active-connection check appears before YouTube.
• Update downloads explain resume or restart; verified installation uses the Android installer.
• Session traffic replaces instantaneous rates in the TV summary; diagnostics is a separate card before YouTube. Unsupported-start errors have a full report and opt-in QR/TXT export to smartphone.

Check top-row Update and Back focus. Press a group name: observe progress, then URL reliability-first sorting; VPN and selected profile must stay unchanged. Cancel: no partial sorting. Compare the diagnostics tile with its full report.

1. Launch with a remote: the last chosen mode is focused. Open the top card, read these notes, and press Back; focus should return to it.
2. Enter TV. Reach every group and the direct section buttons. Choosing a group must not switch the VPN.
3. Import or update a subscription with a provider title; rename it manually and update again. The custom name must remain.
4. Connect a working profile without pressing Tests. Check the automatic result before YouTube, then check actual Internet access. Try a known failing profile and read its reason.
5. When a newer APK is available, interrupt a download and retry. Check whether the UI says resume or restart. After installation verify the version on launch.
6. Check smartphone mode, large fonts, portrait/landscape, and Back from About.
7. Test a failing XHTTP profile: a full diagnostic window must open. Download its report through QR on a trusted LAN; check that closing sharing disables the link.

These notes are bundled with the installed APK and work offline; they do not describe a newer GitHub release.
Many groups require vertical scrolling.
A started VPN service or TCP response does not prove Internet access. The URL check is not a continuous throughput or stability test. Hysteria instability remains under investigation; XHTTP support is not guaranteed.
No automatic background relaunch is forced after installation. The Android installer and notification permissions control the Open prompt. No report or private configuration is uploaded automatically.
